crossRefs.note: “Be silent! Leave me alone, that I may speak. Let come on me what will.
Should your boastings make men hold their peace? When you mock, will no man make you ashamed?
Shall vain words have an end? Or what provokes you that you answer?
“How long will you hunt for words? Consider, and afterwards we will speak.
“How long will you torment me, and crush me with words?
“Listen diligently to my speech. Let this be your consolation.
Allow me, and I also will speak; After I have spoken, mock on.
So these three men ceased to answer Job, because he was righteous in his own eyes.
Even a fool, when he keeps silent, is counted wise. When he shuts his lips, he is thought to be discerning.
For as a dream comes with a multitude of cares, so a fool’s speech with a multitude of words.
Therefore a prudent person keeps silent in such a time, for it is an evil time.
So, then, my beloved brothers, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, and slow to anger;

translations.web: Oh that you would be completely silent! Then you would be wise.
translations.bsb: If only you would remain silent; for that would be your wisdom!
translations.kjv: O that ye would altogether hold your peace! and it should be your wisdom.
translations.asv: Oh that ye would altogether hold your peace! And it would be your wisdom.
